convention: AI greyboxes with solid colored materials. Replace each placeholder with real texture before shipping.

textures.description: AR floor overlay — the virtual carpet/floor being hoovered. Marks coverage progress.
textures.notes: Indoor carpet or hardwood with subtle grain. Tiled 0.25m cells via CoverageMap.cs. This is indoors — no grass. Darkens or desaturates for unvisited cells.

textures.description: Unvisited coverage cell — the dirty/unhoovered version of the floor.
textures.notes: AI: tint floor_carpet dark brown at 40% opacity. Human: replace with actual dusty/filthy carpet texture.

textures.description: Visited coverage cell — the clean/hoovered version.
textures.notes: AI: bright green solid. Human: actual freshly-hoovered clean carpet or pristine floor.

textures.description: LineRenderer material tracing the player's hoovering path in real-time.
textures.notes: Glow effect preferred — like Tron light-trail or GPS track. Should fade over distance. See PathLineVisualizer.cs.

textures.description: AR grid stripe — not yet covered. Player must trace these lines.
textures.notes: White dashed line at 60% opacity. Think football pitch marking. See PerfectGridModeController.cs stripeIdleMat.

textures.description: AR grid stripe — successfully traced by the player.
textures.notes: Same texture as stripe_idle but green glow. Animated shader property _Cleared transition is nice.

textures.description: LineRenderer prefab — one per stripe zone. Instantiated by GenerateStripes().
textures.notes: A thin quad or LineRenderer. Width = stripeWidthMeters (0.5m). Spans room Z axis.

textures.description: Translucent LineRenderer showing the user's best previous run as a ghost trace.
textures.notes: Color: new Color(0.4f, 0.8f, 1f, 0.4f) per GhostRunModeController.cs. Translucent, ethereal, pulsing.

textures.description: Sphere at the tip of the ghost trail — represents where 'past you' is right now.
textures.notes: Small sphere (0.15m). Translucent blue-white. AI: solid sphere with emissive light blue. Human: glowing orb with slight lens flare.

textures.description: Particle system for rooms with chaos score >= 7 (DOOMED).
textures.notes: Animated fire particle. Should look dangerous but comedic — this is a chore app, not Mordor. See ChaosAssessmentModeController.cs fireEffectPrefab.

textures.description: Particle system for rooms with chaos score 4–7 (messy but not doomed).
textures.notes: Wispy grey smoke. Subtle. See ChaosAssessmentModeController.cs smokeEffectPrefab.

textures.description: Dollhouse room material — shows the room in its dirty/uncleaned state.
textures.notes: Grungy overlay: stains, dust, clutter shadows. Transitions to cleanMat via DollhouseManager.cs. opacity ranges 0.6→1.0.

textures.description: Dollhouse room material — pristine/cleaned state.
textures.notes: Warm, clean, inviting. Fresh paint, polished wood feel. Sharp contrast with dirtyMat.

textures.description: Intermediate material used during the 0.8s dirty→clean transition animation.
textures.notes: AI: lerp between dirtyMat and cleanMat colors. Human: actual halfway-cleaned texture with sparkle particles.

textures.description: Pattern cell quad — not yet covered by the player. Shows where to trace.
textures.notes: Gold translucent quad. Color: new Color(0.9f, 0.8f, 0.2f, 0.5f). Player must walk over these cells.

textures.description: Pattern cell quad — successfully traced. Swaps from activeMat when player walks through.
textures.notes: Green vibrant quad. Color: new Color(0.2f, 0.9f, 0.4f, 0.7f). Satisfying pop effect on completion.

textures.description: Particle/effect that plays when player collects (reaches) a clutter item.
textures.notes: Burst of sparkles/gold coins. Auto-destroyed after 2 seconds. Satisfying pickup feel.

textures.description: AR indicator hovering over uncollected clutter items.
textures.notes: AI: red floating exclamation mark or diamond. Human: stylized trash icon or glowing orb with countdown ring.

textures.description: Full-screen overlay shown when player wins a ChoreWars battle.
textures.notes: Bold text: 'YOU WIN' or 'VICTORY'. Splipperverse-appropriate font. Green glow. See ChoreWarsBattleModeController.cs winBanner.

textures.description: Full-screen overlay when opponent wins.
textures.notes: Bold text: 'DEFEATED' or 'BETTER LUCK'. Motivational, not demoralizing. Red/orange tint. See loseBanner.

textures.description: ChoreSelectionUI tile icon — Standard Coverage mode.
textures.notes: AI: solid circle fill with checkmark. Human: stylized hoover icon. Accent: rgb(0.2, 0.8, 1.0).

textures.description: ChoreSelectionUI tile icon — Perfect Grid mode.
textures.notes: AI: grid pattern. Human: carpet stripe pattern / polished floor grid. Accent: rgb(0.1, 0.9, 0.6).

textures.description: ChoreSelectionUI tile icon — Ghost Run mode.
textures.notes: AI: translucent figure outline. Human: ghost with stopwatch. Accent: rgb(0.6, 0.4, 1.0).

textures.description: ChoreSelectionUI tile icon — Chaos Assessment mode.
textures.notes: Fire/magnifying glass. Accent: rgb(1.0, 0.2, 0.2). Tags: 'DOOMED', 'Chaos adjacent' from ChaosAssessmentModeController.cs.

textures.description: ChoreSelectionUI tile icon — Mowing Art mode.
textures.notes: Paintbrush/pattern. Accent: rgb(0.3, 0.9, 0.3).

textures.description: ChoreSelectionUI tile icon — Declutter Dash mode.
textures.notes: Stopwatch / running figure / trash bag. Accent: rgb(1.0, 0.7, 0.1).

textures.description: ChoreSelectionUI tile icon — ChoreWars Battle mode.
textures.notes: Crossed hoovers / swords / versus symbol. Accent: rgb(1.0, 0.3, 0.3).

textures.description: HUD timer panel background — semi-transparent dark bar.
textures.notes: Rounded rect, 80% opacity black. Houses timerLabel, scoreLabel, itemsLabel. Matches Quest system UI aesthetic.

textures.description: Default UI button background for mode selection and lobby panels.
textures.notes: Rounded rect. Subtle border. Hover/pressed states use tint. Splipperverse dark-theme appropriate.

textures.description: Lobby panel background — waiting for opponent screen.
textures.notes: Dark themed panel. 'Waiting for opponent on LAN...' with pulsing dots animation.

textures.description: SessionSummaryUI panel — shows score, coverage %, time after session ends.
textures.notes: Dark panel with score breakdown. Stats: coverage%, bonus points, total score.

textures.description: Shader for OVR spatial mesh — the wireframe/translucent room scan visible in AR.
textures.notes: Chorewars/ProjectedTexture shader. Wireframe with scanline effect. See ProjectedTextureBaker.cs and SpatialMeshTracker.cs.

usage_for_unity_ai.instruction: Create placeholder materials as Unity .mat files with the specified hex colors and names. Place them in Assets/Chorewars/Materials/Placeholders/. Assign each to its controller's serialized field in the Inspector.
usage_for_unity_ai.do_not_do: Do NOT generate AI textures. Solid colored materials ONLY. Let Jonathan or an artist replace them. Indoor theme — no grass, no lawn, no outdoors.
